text:
The evidence does **not establish whether the 2025 loss was caused by clearing for agriculture**. It shows 13.5 hectares of tree-cover loss, or 3.91% of the asset. Most of the affected area was mapped as native forest in 2021.

The data do not identify the cause or subsequent land use, and no later year was available to corroborate the event. Post-loss imagery or land-use evidence would be needed to assess whether the area was converted to agriculture.
